      NEO Explorer

      Interactive 3D map of the inner solar system and ~42,000 near-Earth asteroids, computed live from JPL orbital elements (J2000 ecliptic frame). Every body is propagated from its own epoch by solving Kepler's equation each frame.

      • Time: play/pause, log-speed slider, ⇄ reverses, scrub 1900–2200, or jump to a date.
      • Bodies: dot size tracks absolute magnitude H (brighter = bigger); colour tracks orbit class.
      • Sizes exaggerated ~900× unless “True body sizes” is on — then planets shrink to reality.
      • Comets include hyperbolic/parabolic orbits propagated from perihelion passage.
      • Share: time, selection, camera and layers live in the URL — “Copy link” on any object.
      • Data: NASA/JPL SBDB + CAD + CNEOS Sentry snapshot; see README for provenance.
